data.narrative:
Western Chemicals is a Pre-Seed stage climate and energy company founded by Jared West (Columbia B.S. Physics and Mechanical Engineering, 2020) that has raised $175K to date. The Climate & Energy sector includes 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though the peer set contains no direct same-stage or adjacent-stage matches at Western Chemicals' current valuation tier.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using the $175K total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement yields $438K. A Peer-Median approach was not feasible; while nine Climate & Energy peers exist (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen), none satisfy minimum thresholds for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or comparable valuation-tier filtering. Relying on all-sector median would introduce material bias.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $372K (low) to $503K (high), with a median point of $438K. This range reflects stage-typical expansion from founder and seed capital, not market comparables. Key uncertainties include Western Chemicals' specific technology pathway, commercial timeline, and capital efficiency relative to peers—data not available in this assessment. Any refinement would require closer-stage peer financials or disclosed technology specifics to enable meaningful cross-sectional comparison.
